code_snippet: PROJECT_ROOT="$ws" bash "$ubs" --opt-out "eval sandbox: br not on PATH"
finding: init_sandbox_beads executes $ws/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh — a copy of the MOUNTED tree's code — on the host, in the driver's environment, whenever br is not on PATH (the documented default: Dockerfile.ablation:82-84). Violates the harness's own trust boundary (sandbox-mount.sh:75, pipeline-run.sh:125-126).
reasoning_trace: Traced pipeline-run.sh:489 lib_call init_sandbox_beads → sandbox-mount.sh:505 command -v br (absent on this host) → :511-513 bash on the sandbox copy of the mounted tree (mount_prompt_surface :131 copies $SOURCE_TREE/.claude). Base execute-agent.sh has no beads step, so the path is new in this PR.
critique: The eval.yml trust-boundary scan looks for `source` lines; `bash "$ubs"` evades it while doing the same thing.
remediation: Write the opt-out marker from the harness itself (the script only writes $PROJECT_ROOT/.run/beads-state.json), or run the trusted copy $_SM_REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh with PROJECT_ROOT=$ws, or run the step inside the container.

finding: `label` is a jq keyword; jq 1.6 (the repository's declared floor, .claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh:208) rejects `$label` with 'unexpected label, expecting IDENT'. Same at :816, :881, sandbox-mount.sh:462,467; and the `{name, label, …}` shorthand at ablation-row.sh:285 fails with 'unexpected }'. Every mounted phase dies at the argv capture; write_sandbox_grimoire fails before the first phase.
reasoning_trace: Reproduced on this host (jq-1.6): `jq -n --arg label x '$label'` and `jq -n '{a:1,label:2} | {a, label}'` both fail to compile.
remediation: Rename the jq variable (e.g. --arg lbl) at the five sites; write `"label": .label` in ablation-row.sh; or declare and check jq >= 1.7 and add a jq 1.6 CI leg.

finding: On jq 1.6 the raw slurp of NUL-terminated elements yields no trailing empty element, so `.[:-1]` drops the LAST real element of argv, env and launcher captures: `--effort medium` loses `medium`, `--resume <sid>` loses the id, the env capture loses LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false. took-effect.sh then reports false FAILs (enforce_env_false, effort_flag_medium, implementer_single_session), and a run whose offending element was last would pass.
reasoning_trace: Reproduced: printf '%s\0' a b c | jq -Rs 'split("\u0000") | .[:-1]' → ["a","b"] on jq-1.6.
remediation: Build the arrays without relying on a trailing separator (`rtrimstr("\u0000") | split("\u0000")`, or `--args`/$ARGS.positional); add a test asserting the last argv element and last env key are captured.

finding: The whole MODELINV ledger, the full pipeline.json and both envelopes are passed as --argjson argv strings; Linux caps one argv string at 128 KiB, so a long run's row is never written (set -e aborts before ROW) and runs.jsonl silently lacks the long, expensive runs.
reasoning_trace: Reproduced: a 140001-byte --argjson → '/usr/bin/jq: Argument list too long'. Confirmed by the review's dissent DISS-001 and the review.
remediation: Write the inputs to files and use --slurpfile/--rawfile, or stream the ledger on stdin; add a test with a >128 KiB model-invoke.jsonl.

finding: The new gate compares the committed .claude/checksums.json with the tracked tree, but this PR changes sixteen tracked .claude/ files and does not regenerate the manifest; the gate (and MP-6, tests/unit/check-manifest-paths.bats:88) is red on the PR's own head in every scenario (stale manifest → drift exit 1; absent manifest → exit 1/2).
reasoning_trace: Diff file list: 16 .claude/ paths changed, .claude/checksums.json absent from the diff. The workspace manifest matches head hashes only because the harness regenerated the sandbox manifest (regen_sandbox_manifest), which says nothing about upstream.
remediation: Run tools/gen-checksums.sh on the head tree and commit .claude/checksums.json in this PR; make the release path regenerate it.

finding: took-effect.bats:18 and ablation-row.bats:19 copy evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/runs/, which is not in the change (the fixture dir carries MANIFEST.json, regen.sh, suite.yaml, tasks/, prs/ only); every test in both files fails in setup(), and the new CI step (bats-tests.yml:212-221) runs `bats evals/tests/` unconditionally.
reasoning_trace: ls pr/head/evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/ shows no runs/; the diff is the complete base→head change; regen.sh:86-89 describes the run dirs as tracked fixtures.
remediation: Commit the regenerated runs/ directories, or regenerate them in setup_file() when absent.

finding: In a submodule mount every manifest path exists under .loa/<path> by construction, so `Missing:` is unreachable: a deleted or unlinked guard script, hook or gate now prints an informational not-mounted count and 'Integrity verified' where it failed before.
reasoning_trace: Read of the diff hunk; confirmed by cross-model DISS-C-001 and the review.
remediation: Classify not-mounted only for paths outside the link scope mount-submodule.sh creates; fail for an absent path inside it (at minimum for .claude/scripts and .claude/hooks).

finding: regen_sandbox_manifest executes ${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE}/tools/gen-checksums.sh — the tree under test — which `source`s that tree's .claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh (gen-checksums.sh:51), contradicting the header's 'never .claude/ code'. Unreachable from pipeline-run.sh today (:476 excludes /.claude/ from the sandbox repo), so dead code carrying a trust hole.
reasoning_trace: Branch condition :384-385 requires git ls-files .claude non-empty; pipeline-run.sh excludes .claude; execute-agent.sh never git-inits the workspace.
remediation: Delete the tool branch; keep the inline hashlib path, or run only the trusted copy under $_SM_REPO_ROOT.

FROM rust:1-bookworm AS brbuild
RUN cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 …
finding: The brbuild stage is never COPY --from'd and :82 says the crate is not on crates.io; under the classic builder (DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0) every stage is built and the image build fails.
reasoning_trace: No COPY --from=brbuild anywhere in the Dockerfile; the comment at :82-84 records the decision not to ship br.

finding: The operator's codex auth.json is copied into the per-run HOME that is bind-mounted rw into the container for EVERY container arm, including arms that never run a codex hop (a0_bare, a4_no_gates); the agent under test reads it with --network bridge. remove_tree runs only on trapped exits, so a SIGKILLed driver leaves the copy under meta/home.
reasoning_trace: make_home :563-573 runs unconditionally in container mode (:574); GATES_OFF/LOA_MOUNT are known at :419-421 before it.
remediation: Copy the codex files only when the arm's phase set includes a gate and gates are on; fail closed if meta/home exists at start; document the residual-on-SIGKILL case.

finding: run_phase is 235 lines (argv assembly, launcher, capture, watchdog, reaping, result parsing, snapshot, verdict, pricing, exit decision); the phase-plan jq at :215-229 is duplicated verbatim in took-effect.sh:92-105 so the proof can drift from the plan.
reasoning_trace: Read of both scripts; the capture bug (CQ-002) would have been a one-line fix in a helper.
remediation: Extract capture/record/account blocks; move the plan jq into one shared file read by both scripts.

finding: The count-only integrity check now counts tracked files in whatever tree the manifest symlink points to; whoever controls the symlink chooses the tree. Falls back to the legacy find count when zero.
remediation: Restrict the resolved target to PROJECT_ROOT or .loa/, or replace the count with check-loa.sh's sha256 verification.

finding: voices_run and the DEGRADED / voice-shortfall causes are read from the agent-writable sandbox envelope first (same in took-effect.sh:87); the eval/ fallback is a copy of the same agent-authored file (pipeline-run.sh:776-778), so neither is harness evidence.
reasoning_trace: Read of both readers and the copy step; cross-model DISS-C-003.
remediation: Cross-check voices_run against the MODELINV rows of the gate phases (already joined in the row); record the envelope's source and sha256.

finding: zone_violations.dot_claude_writes counts only Write/Edit-family tool_use inputs; .claude/ edits through Bash (sed -i, redirection, cp, git checkout) are invisible, so the metric under-reports.
reasoning_trace: Cross-model DISS-C-004; the sandbox manifest already exists for an effect-based check.
remediation: Add a post-run hash walk of sandbox/.claude against the regenerated manifest (took-effect.sh's integrity_clean does this) and record drift as a violation.

finding: When bats is not on PATH the script executes a hardcoded path under the running user's home; identical toolchains fingerprint differently per host and a planted binary at that path is run.
reasoning_trace: Read; cross-model DISS-C-005; the review's LOW.
remediation: Drop the fallback; LOA_EVAL_BATS_BIN / --bats-bin already exist.

remediation: Add a `pricing.placeholder: true` marker surfaced as pricing_source=placeholder; close the confirmation bead before release.
